data.name: Luma
data.gender_notes: Luma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-m-m', meaning 'light'. In Islamic tradition, Luma symbolizes illumination, guidance, and enlightenment. The name Luma carries the meaning “Light, Luminous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Luma usually hope their child will grow to embody light, luminous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of hope and guidance, inspiring others to find their way in the darkest of times
data.etymology: Luma belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light, Luminous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Luma total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: لوما
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الضوء أو الشعاع
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم لوما هو اسم مؤنث عربي يعني الضوء أو الشعاع، وقد ورد في بعض التفاسير القرآنية كرمز للنور الإلهي أو للهداية. يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات الإسلامية لإعطاء الفتيات معنى جميلًا ومرتبطًا بالإيمان

in_urdu.name: لما
in_urdu.long_meaning: لما ایک مؤنث نام ہے جس کا مطلب روشنی یا چمک کے شعاع سے ہے۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے اور بعض اوقات قرآنی آیات میں روشنی یا ہدایت کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام لڑکیوں کو دینے کے لئے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے تاکہ ان کی زندگی میں روشنی اور رہبری کی اہمیت کو ظاہر کیا जा سکے

in_hindi.name: लूमा
in_hindi.long_meaning: लूमा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जिसका अर्थ प्रकाश या किरण से है। यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है और कुछ इस्लामी व्याख्याओं में ईश्वरीय प्रकाश या मार्गदर्शन के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम लड़कियों को दिया जाता है ताकि उनके जीवन में प्रकाश और आध्यात्मिकता का महत्व प्रकट हो

in_pashto.name: لوما
in_pashto.long_meaning: لوما يه يو مؤنث نوم دی چی د رڼا یا شعاع معنی یی دی. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستی دی او د ځینو تفسیرونو په قرآن کریم کې د الهي رڼا یا هدایت لپاره کارول کیږي. د پښتنو په کلتور کې، دا نوم د انجونو لپاره کارول کیږي تر څو د هغوی په ژوند کې د رڼا او روحانیت ارزښت وښيي

in_english.name: Luma
in_english.meaning: Means light or beam of light
in_english.long_meaning: Luma is a feminine given name that means light or beam of light. Derived from Arabic roots, this name is sometimes used in Quranic interpretations as a symbol of divine light or guidance. Across Islamic cultures, Luma is bestowed upon girls to signify the importance of illumination and spiritual guidance in their lives. The name has historical significance in Islamic tradition and continues to be used in various Muslim communities worldwide

data.cultural_impact: In Arabic culture, the name Luma is associated with clarity, brightness, and wisdom. It is a beautiful and elegant name that is often given to girls. In Islamic art and literature, Luma is represented as a shining star or a radiant light that illuminates the path for those seeking guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, Luma represents the Light of God that guides the hearts and minds of believers. It is a reminder of the divine guidance that is always present in our lives, guiding us towards the right path. The name Luma is also associated with the light of knowledge and wisdom, which helps us to understand the world around us and to live a meaningful and purposeful life. The Quran says in Surah An-Nur (24:35): "God is the Light of the heavens and the earth. His Light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is in a glass, the glass is as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by the fire. Light upon light. God guides to His Light whom He wills."
